description: Cinema Director for Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance) - high-fidelity text-to-video from a structured director brief, via muapi.ai.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.description: Subject/action for the video, e.g. "hidden Andes temple, mist through the canopy".

inputs.name: intent
inputs.description: Camera/mood intent, e.g. epic, tense, product.

phases.prompt: Write a Seedance 2.0 Director Brief for subject '{{subject}}' with intent '{{intent}}', duration {{duration}}s. Use the six-component hierarchy in order: Scene (environment+lighting), Subject (identity+detail), Action (fluid, physically plausible interaction), Camera (movement+lens+speed), Audio (music+SFX+ambience - mandatory, never omit), Pacing/Style (timing+mood+color grade). For videos of 10s or more, break into timecode segments (0-3s, 3-6s, etc.) with exactly one action beat per segment. Use technical cinematography language only - no vague adjectives like 'beautiful' or '8k'. End with a negative-prompt line: 'Avoid: camera shake, jump cuts, lens distortion, overexposure, watermarks, text overlays.'
